rules.question: Which of the chart folders cannot be read as a folder, so that a library scan must refuse?

exempt.why: declares is_directory_utf8, the disk check every caller uses
defines is_directory_utf8, the disk check every caller uses
tells a file from a folder among the files of a store being upgraded; it reads no chart folder

owner_lines.why: the one loop over the chart folders that names the first unreadable one
the scan walk skips a root that is not a folder; that decides what to walk, not whether to refuse

must_match: for (const std::string& f : settings.chartfolders) ok = ok && is_directory_utf8(f);
rules.note: The scan walk in analysis.cpp skips a root that is not a folder, which is its own question (what to walk), so both lines in the owner file are listed. Any other line that checks a folder on disk is flagged: a chart folder check outside the owner would give the app and hydra_batch two answers to which folder is missing. Decided by: D268 (D266 item 4).
